project_summary: Engineering initiative to implement Google OAuth authentication to unblock enterprise user onboarding, repair mobile-compatible token-based password reset links via email, and enforce 7-day inactivity session expiration using secure HttpOnly JWT cookies.
identified_risks: Account duplication or linking conflicts between existing email/password users and Google OAuth accounts.
Handling edge cases on mobile web view user-agents where email deep links or cookies might be blocked or restricted.
Potential CSRF/XSS vulnerabilities if HttpOnly cookies do not include appropriate SameSite and Secure flags.

user_stories.title: Google OAuth Single Sign-On Integration
user_stories.user_story: As an enterprise user, I want to sign in using my Google account, so that I can onboard quickly without creating a new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the login page, When they click 'Sign in with Google', Then they are redirected to Google's authentication consent screen.
Given Google authentication is successful, When the user is redirected back to the app, Then an authenticated session is established and the user is navigated to the dashboard.

user_stories.title: Secure Email Password Reset Flow
user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to receive a secure token-based password reset link in my email, so that I can reset my password safely on both desktop and mobile web views.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, When they submit a valid registered email address, Then a secure, single-use reset token link is dispatched via email.
Given the user clicks the reset link on a mobile web view, When they enter and submit a valid new password, Then the password is updated and previous reset tokens are invalidated.

user_stories.title: HttpOnly JWT Cookie Session Management & Expiration
user_stories.user_story: As a system user, I want my session token stored securely in an HttpOnly cookie and auto-expired after 7 days of inactivity, so that my account remains secure against unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user logs in successfully, When the JWT is generated, Then it is stored strictly in a secure HttpOnly cookie.
Given a user has been inactive for 7 consecutive days, When they make an authenticated request, Then the session is rejected and the user is redirected to log in.
